criteria.criterion: A new crate crates/athena-cap-study exists with its own Cargo.toml (workspace package/lint inheritance, no edits to any [lints] table) and src/lib.rs, and is a member of the workspace.
criteria.evidence: From reading the diff: crates/athena-cap-study/Cargo.toml takes version, edition, rust-version, license and publish from the workspace and sets `[lints] workspace = true`. No other [lints] table is touched. The root Cargo.toml adds the crate to `members` and to `[workspace.dependencies]`. src/lib.rs exists.

criteria.criterion: The crate defines typed records from design §4 with a schema field: study.pin/1, study.source/1, study.claim/1, study.run/1, study.rationale/1, study.finding/1, study.gap/1, study.validation/1, plus study.model/1 with the §5.1 elements. Numbers are Quantity values (measured or labeled estimate), not bare numbers.
criteria.evidence: From reading the code: records.rs has schema constants for all eight study.*/1 records, and model.rs has MODEL_SCHEMA "study.model/1". The model has states with kinds, counters, transitions (trigger, guard, evaluated-by, actor, failure, retry with bound, backoff and changes), unhandled failures, concurrency and touchpoints, which matches §5.1. The run's cap and cost are athena_data::Quantity. The only bare integers are line numbers, retry bounds and limits. Finding has `subject` (R2-m2) and a ReplayDifference kind (R2-m3).

criteria.criterion: The crate implements the §5.4 validation rules as pure functions over records, each classed evidence (non-waivable) or model (waivable); a waiver clears only a model rule and only when it names the rule and ids and cites a user intervention record.
criteria.evidence: From reading rules.rs: RULES lists all 18 rules of the §5.4 table, 8 Evidence and 10 Model, each a `fn(&Study) -> Vec<Violation>`. In validate(), waived() is called only when `rule.class == Class::Model`. waived() requires kind Waiver, a matching rule, a non-blank reason, an intervention in user_interventions, and every offending id in subject. The tests a_waiver_that_is_not_valid_clears_nothing and an_evidence_rule_cannot_be_waived cover this.

criteria.criterion: Rules that need git lookups (Wrong SHA, Bad citation, Quote mismatch) go through a small trait or fixture repository, not the live network.
criteria.evidence: From reading rules.rs: the trait GitLookup (file_lines, reachable) and the in-memory FixtureRepo. Study carries `git: &dyn GitLookup`, and cited_lines and bad_citation call only that trait.

criteria.criterion: The crate implements the core Capability trait (id "study", card, producer and verifier prompt sections under crates/athena-cap-study/prompts/) but is NOT registered in athena-cli wiring, and does not run any studied system.
criteria.evidence: From reading lib.rs: `impl Capability for Study` with ID "study", a card, and include_str! of prompts/producer.md and prompts/verifier.md. A Grep for cap.study/cap_study across crates/ found only the crate's own Cargo.toml, so athena-cli does not reference it. Nothing in the crate spawns a process.

criteria.criterion: docs/architecture.md gains an athena-cap-study row listing its dependency edges, matching the actual Cargo.toml dependencies.
criteria.evidence: The new row lists "core, data, context". Cargo.toml depends on athena-context, athena-core and athena-data, plus the external crates jiff and serde. The xtask policy test dependency_direction_matches_the_architecture passed.

criteria.criterion: CHANGELOG.md records the new crate; a decisions.md entry records the scope call (validation core only; containment, run step, and Pages publishing deferred).
criteria.evidence: CHANGELOG has a new bullet for athena-cap-study under the unreleased section. docs/decisions.md adds D65, which defers containment, the run step, replay, Pages and CLI registration, with alternatives, tradeoff, reversal cost and provenance.

criteria.evidence: Both runs passed: 28 study-crate tests and every workspace suite, including xtask policy (8 passed). criteria.evidence: The working tree is clean. The 13 changed files contain nothing under records/ and no governance file. The largest new file is rules.rs at 44353 bytes, under max_file_bytes 1048576 in athena.toml. A Grep for email patterns found none in the new crate.

findings.summary: unbounded_retry accepts any non-empty bound_absent_claims without checking that the cited claim ids exist.
findings.evidence: The filter is `r.bound.is_none() && r.bound_absent_claims.is_empty()`. A bound_absent claim id that matches no claim still passes. Element claim lists in uncited_element have the same gap.

findings.summary: The design doc is modified but was not in the expected deliverables, and two expected modifications (athena-data records.rs, athena-core capability.rs) were not made.
findings.evidence: git diff --stat shows the design doc changed and neither listed file changed. The design edits apply R2-m1/m2/m3, which the reading assumed. Leaving the trait and AnyRecord unchanged follows the out-of-scope guidance, and D65 records it.

summary: The candidate meets the request as the user's accepted reading defines it. It adds the athena-cap-study crate with typed study.*/1 records, the study.model/1 model, and all 18 §5.4 rules as pure functions: 8 evidence rules that cannot be waived and 10 model rules that only a valid user waiver can clear. Git lookups go through a GitLookup trait backed by an in-memory fixture. The crate implements the Capability trait with its two prompts, is not wired into the CLI, and runs no studied system. The architecture table, CHANGELOG and decision D65 are updated, and the review-2 changes are applied to the design. I ran `cargo test --locked`, `cargo test --quiet`, clippy with -D warnings, `cargo fmt --check`, `git status` and `git diff --stat`; all were clean. Every rule has a test with a clean case and a planted fault. No governance or records/ files changed, no file is near the size limit, and the new crate contains no email addresses. One minor gap: claim-id lists are not checked to point at claims that exist.
